question: Which weapon and power are associated with the world-lady?
premises: The verse names bhuvaneśyā, netra-astra, śakti, and mādana.
It emphasizes the association with indeed.
inference: The world-lady is associated with eye-weapon, power, and intoxicating force.
plain_english: World-lady, eye-weapon, power, and intoxicating force are named.
